optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Procurement Operations Specialist, Customer Ticketing System

professionalSummary.text: Maintains the vendor contract register and renewal calendar for the support product's hosting, telephony, and translation vendors, sending renewal alerts ninety days ahead and reconciling the register with finance's purchase orders.
professionalSummary.witness: Maintained the vendor contract register and the renewal calendar for the support product's hosting, telephony and translation vendors, sending renewal alerts ninety days ahead and keeping the register reconciled with finance's purchase orders.

professionalSummary.text: Prepares renewal briefs including usage, spend, service credits, and benchmark prices for the head of procurement's use in negotiations; contract values were signed off by the head of procurement and, above her limit, by the CFO.
professionalSummary.witness: Prepared the renewal briefs (usage, spend, service credits, benchmark prices) that the head of procurement used in renewal negotiations; contract values were signed off by the head of procurement and, above her limit, by the CFO.

professionalSummary.text: Organizes quarterly vendor reviews with service owners, circulating scorecards and recording actions; vendor exits were decided by the head of procurement.
professionalSummary.witness: Organised the quarterly vendor reviews with the service owners, circulating the scorecards and recording the actions; vendor exits were decided by the head of procurement.

professionalSummary.text: Updates the vendor risk register each quarter from security team assessments and service owners' incident notes, and writes the quarter-end note on open risks and hand-over items.
professionalSummary.witness: Updated the vendor risk register each quarter from the security team's assessments and the service owners' incident notes, and wrote the quarter-end note on open risks and hand-over items.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained vendor contract register and renewal calendar for support product vendors over two and a half years.
experienceHighlights.witness: Responsibilities included register maintenance, renewal briefs, review organisation and risk-register updates for the support product's vendors over about two and a half years.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared renewal briefs for the head of procurement's use in negotiations over two and a half years.
experienceHighlights.witness: Responsibilities included register maintenance, renewal briefs, review organisation and risk-register updates for the support product's vendors over about two and a half years.

experienceHighlights.text: Organized quarterly vendor reviews with service owners over two and a half years.
experienceHighlights.witness: Responsibilities included register maintenance, renewal briefs, review organisation and risk-register updates for the support product's vendors over about two and a half years.

experienceHighlights.text: Updated vendor risk register each quarter from security and service owners' inputs over two and a half years.
experienceHighlights.witness: Responsibilities included register maintenance, renewal briefs, review organisation and risk-register updates for the support product's vendors over about two and a half years.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Work sample: one renewal brief for the telephony vendor and vendor risk register extract for one quarter, with procurement system record identifiers as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: one renewal brief for the telephony vendor and the vendor risk register extract for one quarter, with the procurement system's record identifiers as a verification trail.

skills.text: Vendor portfolio management for hosting, telephony, and translation services.
skills.witness: Maintained the vendor contract register and the renewal calendar for the support product's hosting, telephony and translation vendors... Responsibilities included register maintenance, renewal briefs, review organisation and risk-register updates for the support product's vendors

The candidate prepared renewal briefs for the head of procurement, who signed off on contract values.
